issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' not filled. Rule 5 explicitly prohibits this pattern in merged code. The url attribute should contain the recipe repository URL.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set url to the actual recipe repository URL (e.g., the cnb.cool or internal Conan repo URL), or remove the url attribute if not applicable.

issues.description: Patches field is empty ([]), but a patch file 'patches/0001-Makefile.patch' exists and is not declared. Rule 12 requires patches to be declared in the patches field. The conanfile.py uses replace_in_file() in build() instead of conandata patches, making the export_conandata_patches/apply_conandata_patches calls no-ops. This is an inconsistent approach — the patch file and the replace_in_file duplicate the same change.
issues.fix_suggestion:
Declare the patch in conandata.yml: 'patches:
  - patch_file: "patches/0001-Makefile.patch"
    patch_description: "0001 Makefile"
    patch_type: "portability"'. Then remove the replace_in_file() call in build() and rely on apply_conandata_patches() instead. This is the proper Conan 2 approach.

issues.description: Uses 'software:' as the field name instead of 'name:' as specified in code style rule 14. The standard manifest.yaml format requires 'name: <package_name>'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'software: pigz' to 'name: pigz' to match the code style standard.

issues.description: configure_options records '-I$HOME/usr/local/include' (line 13) and '-L$HOME/usr/local/lib' (line 14) as hardcoded local development paths. These do not match the conanfile.py build() method, which correctly uses Conan dependency paths (zlib.cpp_info.includedirs / zlib.cpp_info.libdirs). The metadata is misleading — it suggests the build uses local paths rather than Conan-managed dependency paths.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update configure_options to reflect the actual Conan recipe behavior: 'CFLAGS=-O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unknown-pragmas -Wcast-qual -fPIC -I<zlib_cpp_info_includedirs>' and 'LDFLAGS=-L<zlib_cpp_info_libdirs>'.

issues.description: patches_applied lists '0001-Makefile.patch' as applied, but the patch is NOT applied via conandata (conandata.yml has patches: []). The actual change is done via replace_in_file() in conanfile.py build(). The patches_applied field is inaccurate.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either declare the patch in conandata.yml and apply it via apply_conandata_patches() (then patches_applied is accurate), or update patches_applied to reflect the replace_in_file approach (e.g., 'patches_applied: []' with a note about replace_in_file).

issues.description: patch_generation.source_orig_dir ('/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/pigz-2.8.orig', line 31) and source_work_dir ('/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/pigz-2.8.work', line 32) contain hardcoded absolute local machine paths. These expose the local filesystem structure in a committed file and are not portable.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace local absolute paths with relative paths or generic placeholders (e.g., '$BUILD_DIR/pigz-2.8.orig').

issues.description: Template placeholder '待补充' (to be filled) remains in the conversation record section: '**发现的问题**: 待补充具体问题记录'. Rule 5 prohibits unfilled template placeholders in merged code. Similar placeholders also appear at line 57 (source modification table: '| 待补充 | - | - | - |') and line 62 (delivery table: '| pigz-2.8-ohos-aarch64.tar.gz | 待补充 | 主包 |').
issues.fix_suggestion: Fill in the actual problem records, source modification details (e.g., 'Makefile | HMDFS hard link fix | replace_in_file | applied'), and delivery file size.

issues.description: Status inconsistency: notes.md basic info table (line 12) says '状态: ⚠️ partial' and the 结束记录 section (line 65) says '最终状态: partial', but the bottom (line 70) says '最终状态: published'. The manifest.yaml says 'status: published'. The stale 'partial' entries create confusion about the actual build status.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update all status references in notes.md to consistently show 'published' to match manifest.yaml. Change line 12 to '| 状态 | ✅ published |' and line 65 to '- **最终状态**: published'.

issues.description: patch_classification has 'guard: pending' which appears to be an incomplete/placeholder value. Should indicate whether the patch uses a platform guard (e.g., '#ifdef __OHOS__') or 'none' if no guard is used.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set guard to 'none' since the 0001-Makefile.patch does not use an #ifdef guard — it unconditionally changes 'ln -f' to 'ln -sf'.

issues.description: Build command hardcodes 'LIBS="-lm -lpthread -lz"' with '-lz' as the zlib library name, instead of using zlib.cpp_info.libs from the Conan dependency. While zlib's library is conventionally named 'z', hardcoding it is less robust if the zlib recipe changes its library name or uses static linking with a different name.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider building LIBS dynamically: 'zlib_libs = " ".join(f"-l{lib}" for lib in zlib.cpp_info.libs)' and use it in the make command.

issues.description: source_orig_hash (7bbf420dcc23dec6) and source_work_hash (0c55de48bdd09818) are only 16 hex characters — non-standard hash length. SHA-256 is 64 chars, SHA-1 is 40 chars, MD5 is 32 chars. These appear to be truncated hashes, which reduces their integrity verification value.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use full-length hashes (SHA-256 preferred) for source integrity verification.

issues.description: commands.json has 'binary: false' for version 2.8, while manifest.yaml (both version and software level) says 'status: published'. If 'published' means CI upload succeeded (including binary), then 'binary: false' may be semantically inconsistent. Clarification needed on whether 'published' implies binary availability.
issues.fix_suggestion: If the binary was published to the Conan remote, set 'binary: true'. If only the recipe was published (build-from-source), ensure the manifest status reflects this (e.g., 'recipe-published' or add a note).

issues.description: export_conandata_patches(self) in export_sources() and apply_conandata_patches(self) in build() are called, but conandata.yml has 'patches: []', making both calls no-ops. These redundant calls add confusion — readers may expect patches to be applied via conandata.
issues.fix_suggestion: If using the replace_in_file approach, remove both export_conandata_patches and apply_conandata_patches calls. If using conandata patches, declare the patch in conandata.yml and remove the replace_in_file call.

summary: Audit of pigz 2.8 (feat/pigz-2.8 branch) — 10 changed files reviewed against code_style and review_memory rules. VERDICT: PASS (no P0 deception or P1 recipe correctness issues found). P0 deception checks all passed: (1) R34 stub-test detection — test_package/conanfile.py genuinely runs the pigz binary to compress/decompress files with content assertions, NOT a stub; (2) sha256 'eb872b4f0e1f0ebe59c9f7bd8c506c4204893ba6a8492de31df416f0d5170fd0' verified against official zlib.net/pigz/ page — exact match; (3) URL 'https://zlib.net/pigz/pigz-2.8.tar.gz' is the official source (R39 pass); (4) No hardcoded paths in conanfile.py — build() uses self.conf.get() for compiler (R33 pass) and zlib.cpp_info for dependency paths; (5) R32 OHOS platform check correct: if self.settings.os not in ('Linux', 'OHOS'). P1 recipe correctness checks all passed: Conan 2 API used correctly (from conan import ConanFile), package_type='application' correct for CLI tool, package_info sets cpp_info.bindirs, commands.json declared at software level (R38 pass). 8 P2 code-style issues found (template placeholder url='', inconsistent patches approach, manifest field naming, stale configure_options metadata, inaccurate patches_applied, local machine paths in metadata, unfilled notes.md placeholders, status inconsistency). 5 P3 suggestions (incomplete guard field, hardcoded -lz lib name, short hashes, binary/status semantic ambiguity, redundant conandata patch calls). The recipe (conanfile.py) itself is correct and sound — all issues are in metadata/documentation quality.
